name: audit-ledger
description: Hash-chained audit ledger of tool calls, turns, subagent spawns and mod capability calls, with a forked completion-integrity supervisor.

ledgerDir.title: Ledger directory
ledgerDir.description: Where segments are written: relative to the project root, or absolute.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe records after each tool call; enforce records intent first and refuses any tool call it cannot record.

supervise.title: Completion supervisor
supervise.description: claims forks a supervisor only when an answer claims completion; always forks after every answer; off disables it.

capture.title: Payload capture
capture.description: excerpt keeps a redacted 500-character excerpt beside each SHA-256 digest; digest keeps the digest and size alone.
